command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0063/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: All four 0.34.0 rows, twice each, eight instructions and 32 bytes: both directions over %rsp and %r12, each with %rax (REX.R = 0) and %r8 (REX.R = 1). REX.W is a template constant and REX.B is too -- 48 under %rsp, 49 under %r12 -- so the four REX bytes are 48/4c/49/4d and REX.R at [2,1] is the only bit the operand owns. ModRM = 04 (mod = 00, r/m = 100 announces the SIB) and SIB = 24 (scale = 00, index = 100 meaning none, base = 100) are template bytes. The base is not an operand, so a base or disp operand is E-OPERAND-002 and the rows for %rbp/%r13 stay the RIP-relative or disp8 shapes. input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 32-byte .text.
